result.summary: The page layout looks intact, but some text and navigation elements have low contrast.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation icons and labels are light gray on white, making them difficult to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray that meets contrast requirements for text and icons.

issues.description: The search placeholder has low contrast against the light gray search field.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text or provide a higher-contrast search label.
